title: Repinned pinned-27b on datawatch-ollama — it had been evicted
body: Ollama on node datawatch-ollama had no pinned-27b loaded, so datawatch loaded it again with keep_alive -1 to keep it pinned.

title: Repinned pinned-27b on datawatch-ollama — it had been evicted
body: Ollama on node datawatch-ollama had no pinned-27b loaded, so datawatch loaded it again with keep_alive -1 to keep it pinned. It had been replaced by other-70b.
